# Clarity Templates

> Small independent store of honest digital products: browser games, a privacy-first sleep app, ebooks, printable planners and clipart. Every free tier genuinely works; guides disclose when they mention our own products.

## Guides

- [What Is a Good Sleep Score? How to Read Yours Properly](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/what-is-a-good-sleep-score/): What sleep scores actually measure, why 82 last night doesn't mean what you think, and the two numbers worth watching instead.
- [Rain, Brown Noise or Silence? The Best Sounds for Sleep](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/best-sounds-for-sleep/): What sleep sounds actually do, the honest differences between white, pink and brown noise, and when silence beats all of them.
- [Free Browser Games With No Download: What's Actually Worth Playing](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/free-browser-games-no-download/): How to find browser games that are genuinely good, the red flags to avoid, and the game types that work brilliantly with no download at all.
- [Can a Phone App Really Track Your Deep Sleep? An Honest Answer](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/sleep-tracking-apps-accuracy/): What phone sleep trackers can genuinely measure, what they only estimate, and how to use one without being misled by its numbers.
- [How to Fall Asleep Faster: 9 Things That Actually Work](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/guides/how-to-fall-asleep-faster/): Nine evidence-based ways to fall asleep faster, why most sleep advice fails, and the one habit that matters more than all the others combined.

## Free things you can use right now

- [Rested — free sleep app tier](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/sleep/): runs in the browser, everything stays on your device
- [SKYLINE](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/skyline/): 3D web-swinging browser game, free demo
- [The Sleep Score Lab](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/score-lab/): interactive demo — mix your own sleep-score recipe and watch one identical night score 45 or 95
- [The Honest Sleep Book](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/book/): book in progress with a live, honest chapter-status list
- [All game demos](https://tsjenn.github.io/Sj/): five free browser game demos on the homepage
